t: You're on The Bishops Avenue, a residential road in north London that links the northern edge of Hampstead Heath at Kenwood with East Finchley. It lies near the boundary between the boroughs of Barnet and Haringey. It's considered one of the wealthiest streets in the world, and it's often nicknamed Billionaires' Row. The name comes from Arthur Winnington-Ingram, who was Bishop of London from 1901 to 1939. So a street now known for great wealth carries the name of a churchman.
